question: Which of the following sites provides evidence of early urban planning during the Middle Iron Age in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kausambi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kausambi** is an important archaeological site that provides substantial evidence of **early urban planning** during the **Middle Iron Age in India**.
 
• Located in present-day **Uttar Pradesh**, Kausambi was a significant city in the ancient kingdom of Vatsa.
 
• Excavations at Kausambi have revealed a well-planned city layout with **fortifications, gates, and bastions**, showcasing advanced urban planning techniques.
 
• The site includes remnants of **drainage systems**, indicating a focus on sanitation and organized infrastructure.
 
• Kausambi was an important center of trade and governance, highlighting its role in the **economic and political landscape** of the time.
 
• It is also associated with the **Buddhist tradition**, as it was visited by Gautama Buddha and later became a center of Buddhist learning.
 
• Kausambi's urban planning reflects the transition from rural to organized urban centers during the **Iron Age** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Harappa**__

 __
 
• **Harappa** is a major site of the **Indus Valley Civilization**, which predates the Middle Iron Age.
 
• It is located in present-day **Pakistan** and is known for its advanced urban planning, including **grid layouts, drainage systems, and granaries**.
 
• However, it does not belong to the **Middle Iron Age** but to the earlier **Bronze Age (3300–1300 BCE)**.
 
 
 
• **Lothal**__
 __
 
• **Lothal**, located in present-day Gujarat, was another site of the **Indus Valley Civilization**.
 
• It is famous for its **dockyard** and is considered one of the earliest known ports in the world.
 
• Like Harappa, it belongs to the **Bronze Age** and not the **Middle Iron Age**.
 
 
 
• **Mohenjo-Daro**__
 
 
• **Mohenjo-Daro** is one of the most prominent cities of the **Indus Valley Civilization**.
 
• It is located in present-day **Pakistan** and is known for its **Great Bath**, advanced drainage systems, and urban infrastructure.
 
• Similar to Harappa and Lothal, it belongs to the **Bronze Age**, not the Middle Iron Age.
